title: Has oxygen in the thermocline changed since 1993
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine whether oxygen between about 200 and 1000 m has changed since 1993, where and at which depths, whether the changes are trends or decadal variability, and what could explain them.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
